title: xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy
why_read: A structured knowledge graph of K-12 math, English, and physics curricula with adaptive diagnostics, interesting for people working on educational technology or knowledge-graph-based learning systems.
analysis: This project builds a knowledge graph connecting 1,644 topics across elementary-to-high-school math, English, and junior-high physics, with prerequisite relationships and nearly seven thousand practice questions aligned to curriculum standards. It also includes adaptive diagnostic tools to assess a student's starting knowledge before recommending content. This is a solid example of applying graph structures to educational content sequencing, a nontrivial data modeling and curation effort. Its interest is mostly to those building adaptive learning platforms or studying curriculum knowledge graphs, less so to general software engineers.
